description: Chat Saving Architecture archive capability gate. Grants the renderer the minimum READ/METADATA access for the app-owned saved-chat archive / content-addressed store (CAS) under $APPLOCALDATA/archive, and NO mutation authority whatsoever. M05 G1 CUTOVER: fs:allow-write-file and fs:allow-mkdir were removed. Every write under $APPLOCALDATA/archive now happens in trusted Rust — CAS objects through h2o_archive_durable_write / h2o_archive_cas_repair_write (which create their own ancestors and shards descriptor-relatively), and saved-chat packages through the staged immutable generation publisher (h2o_archive_generation_begin / _write_member / _commit / _abort), which derives the final generation path from its own recomputed contentHash. The renderer therefore cannot create, overwrite, truncate or pre-create any package, staging or CAS path, which is what makes a published generation immutable in practice rather than only by convention. Retained scopes: exists/read-file/lstat over archive/** (CAS blob verification lives under archive/assets, package reads under archive/packages) and read-dir scoped to archive/packages for C5 archive/package diagnostics. Still NO remove/rename, and no broad $HOME/$APPLOCALDATA access. The live archive/CAS root remains deliberately separate from the Sync lane's $HOME/H2O Studio Sync/ folder (ADR-0009, ADR-0010). DP-M03-D's fs:allow-lstat remains at the existing $APPLOCALDATA/archive/** scope for the governed pre-read physical size bound (DP-M03-C). F.3's dev-only remote-origin scope (http://127.0.0.1:1430 / http://localhost:1430) remains so this capability also applies to the WebView served by the local dev server under `tauri dev`; it is inert in production builds, which load over tauri://.
